title: Образец: резюме Backend/LLM (EN)
note:
Показывает форму, плотность и тон. Цифры, компании и проекты условные: не копировать, брать только факты кандидата. - The top third passes the six-second test: exact title, location with timezone and "Open to remote", stack, and a production outcome in the summary.
- Every experience bullet is X/Y/Z, starts with a different past-tense verb and carries a number with its context. Examples: "over 12k articles", "p95 from 900 ms to 300 ms".
- LLM work is described as engineering: evals, cost, latency, observability. Hiring teams for LLM roles look for exactly this.
- Skills are grouped and contain no soft skills or ratings. Projects compensate for short tenure, and dates are consistent `Mon YYYY`.
- The years of experience are never stated or apologised for. The dates speak, and the evidence answers the seniority doubt (4.7).
- It's about 370 words, one page, single column, with standard headings an ATS can parse.
text:
[Name]
Backend / LLM Engineer (Python)
Almaty, Kazakhstan (UTC+5) · Open to remote · [email] · Telegram @[handle] · github.com/[handle] · linkedin.com/in/[handle]

SUMMARY
Python backend engineer building LLM features in production: FastAPI services, RAG over PostgreSQL/pgvector, and evaluation pipelines that make model changes safe. At Company A, shipped an AI support assistant now used by ~3,000 customers weekly.

SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, Bash
Backend: FastAPI, Django REST Framework, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, Celery, asyncio, REST API design
LLM: OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), pgvector, function calling, LLM evaluation
Data & Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, AWS (EC2, S3), Prometheus, Grafana
Testing: pytest, load testing (Locust)

EXPERIENCE
Backend / LLM Engineer, Company A (B2B SaaS, customer-support automation), Almaty    Aug 2025 – Present
- Built a RAG service (FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector) over 12k help-center articles that resolves ~35% of incoming tickets without a human agent.
- Cut median LLM response time from 6.1 s to 2.4 s by streaming tokens, caching embeddings in Redis and moving document chunking to Celery workers.
- Designed an offline eval set of 400 real customer questions with automated pass/fail checks; used it to compare 3 models and lower cost per answer by 40% at equal accuracy.
- Migrated 5 Django endpoints to async FastAPI with typed Pydantic schemas and 85% test coverage; p95 latency fell from 900 ms to 300 ms.
- Added structured logging and Grafana dashboards for token spend and error rates, exposing a retry bug that had doubled API costs.

PROJECTS
Document Q&A Telegram bot | github.com/[handle]/[repo]
- Async bot (aiogram, FastAPI) answering questions over uploaded PDFs with source citations; 150+ users, Docker deploy via GitHub Actions.
LLM eval harness (open source) | github.com/[handle]/[repo]
- CLI that runs prompt and model variants against a YAML test suite and reports pass rate, latency and cost per case; runs in CI to block quality regressions.
Open-source fix | [library]
- Merged PR fixing [bug] in [Python library]; added regression tests requested by maintainers.
Hackathon [event], 2nd place of 40 teams    2024
- Built a natural-language-to-SQL assistant over a retail database in 48 hours (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenAI function calling).

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science, [University], Almaty    2021 – 2025
- Thesis: hybrid keyword + vector search for Russian and Kazakh documents. Relevant courses: Databases, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning.

LANGUAGES
English: C1 (professional working) · Russian: native · Kazakh: native

title: Образец: резюме Backend/LLM (RU)
note:
Показывает форму, плотность и тон. Цифры, компании и проекты условные: не копировать, брать только факты кандидата. - It is written natively for the Russian market, not translated: bullets use perfective past verbs without «я» («Разработал», «Сократил», «Перевёл»), the house style of the strongest RU exemplars and S33's verb list.
- There are no adjective lists. «О себе» holds facts and one result, as S32, S33 and S37 require.
- The header includes the Telegram nick and work format, because recruiters start in Telegram.
- Dates are «месяц ГГГГ – настоящее время». Numbers use Russian notation («6,1 до 2,4 с», «12 тыс.»).
- The facts are identical to the EN version.
- For an hh.ru profile, add «Желаемая должность и зарплата» (gross or net stated, S36) and optionally a business photo. For a PDF sent to remote or international teams, keep it without a photo.

title: Образец: короткое письмо рекрутеру (EN)
note:
Показывает форму, плотность и тон. Цифры, компании и проекты условные: не копировать, брать только факты кандидата. - The first sentence names the exact role and the second ties a **specific** company detail to the candidate's own work. That is the "obviously personalized" signal recruiters filter on. There is no "I am writing to express…".
- One paragraph of proof with 3 numbers that map to the JD's core problem, without repeating the CV line by line.
- Logistics appear only as relevant facts (timezone overlap, English). The CV is attached and the CTA is concrete and small.
- Within the 5–10-sentence and 700–900-character band. No self-deprecation, no "perfect fit", no em dashes.
- Years of experience are deliberately absent (4.7).
text:
Hi [Name],

I'm applying for the Backend Engineer (LLM) role at [Company]. [One specific detail from the job post or product, e.g. "Moving support search to RAG"] is close to what I've shipped over the past year at Company A.

There I built a FastAPI + pgvector service that now resolves ~35% of support tickets without an agent, and cut median LLM latency from 6.1 s to 2.4 s with streaming and Redis caching. I also set up a 400-question eval set that let us switch models and cut cost per answer by 40%. I'd bring the same eval-first approach to [team/product].

I'm in Almaty (UTC+5), work remotely in English and can overlap with European mornings. My CV is attached. Happy to do a technical call this week.

[Name]

title: Образец: сообщение рекрутеру в Telegram (RU)
note:
Показывает форму, плотность и тон. Цифры, компании и проекты условные: не копировать, брать только факты кандидата. - It follows the Telegram-first pattern of the RU market: greeting by name, which vacancy and where it was seen, a one-line identity with stack, then 3 short quantified bullets.
- One line maps the JD stack to daily work, then format and timezone, the attached CV, and a soft question as the CTA.
- About 660 characters, so it fits one phone screen.
- No «ответственный / быстро обучаюсь», no «Уважаемый работодатель», no apologies about experience.
- Facts match the CV exactly.
- On hh.ru, the same text works in the reply box. Remove the bullets if the form strips them.
